video_goal: Demonstrate the visual steps to safely remove a full waste toner bottle and install a new one in a Canon imageRUNNER ADVANCE C3530.
required_subjects_and_props: Canon imageRUNNER ADVANCE C3530 printer, full waste toner bottle, new replacement waste toner bottle, flat surface

outline_steps.visual_action: A person approaches the Canon imageRUNNER ADVANCE C3530 printer and reaches out to grip the right edge of the front cover panel.
The hand pulls the front cover panel open, swinging it to the left to reveal the internal toner cartridges and lower compartments.
The camera pans down below the colored toner cartridges to focus on the frosted plastic waste toner bottle seated in the lower cavity.
A thumb presses down on the colored release lever located on the left side of the waste toner bottle.
The hand grips the center handle of the waste toner bottle and pulls it straight out of the machine, revealing the dark toner powder inside the frosted plastic.
The person carefully places the full waste toner bottle upright onto a nearby flat desk surface to prevent any powder from spilling.
Two hands open a cardboard box and lift out a clean, empty replacement waste toner bottle.
The hand holds the new waste toner bottle and aligns the grooves on its bottom edge with the guide rails inside the Canon C3530's lower cavity.
The hand pushes the new waste toner bottle smoothly into the slot until it stops flush against the back wall.
The colored release lever snaps upward, clicking securely over the left edge of the newly inserted bottle.
The hand pushes the front cover panel of the printer back to the right until it clicks firmly shut.
The Canon imageRUNNER ADVANCE C3530 touchscreen interface refreshes, clearing the warning message and displaying the standard 'Ready to print' home screen.
